Use this information to enhance the draft:
The role is 'Claimant & Defendant', use if not specify.

Reply is usually direct, eg 'The claimant admits paragraph 1,2 and 3 of the statement of defence.', 'The claimant states in response to paragraph 3 of the statement of defence, that...', 'The claimant denies paragraph 4 of the statement of defence.', 'The claimant avers that...'.

For reply, the last paragraph sometimes looks like this, eg 'The claimant reaffirms its reliefs as contained in the statement of claim and shall at the trial of this suit pray this honourable court to discountenance the defence of the defendant and enter judgement in its favour.'

The draft should be within 200-9000 words.

Use today's date, to fill the date section.
